SyntheticCJK.ttf and SyntheticCJK.otf are generated by scripts/generate-font-fixtures.py. They are original synthetic test fonts under this repository's MIT license, not excerpts from a third-party font. Both include Chinese codepoints, distinct horizontal/vertical metrics, an fi ligature and AV kerning. Regeneration requires fontTools, but CI uses the checked-in fixtures and does not require Python.
